This report covers only the evolution of MongoDB Atlas Resource Policies and their use of the Cedar policy language: when each stage shipped, what changed, and where the primary sources are. It does not cover Atlas RBAC roles, Atlas IAM generally, other policy engines (OPA/Rego, OpenFGA), or Cedar's use in other products. Those are separate frontier items.
